gloss: person who encounters; witness (to an event)

definitions.gloss: person who encounters (something); witness to an event
definitions.explanation: A person who has come across or experienced a particular event, incident, or phenomenon. Often used in contexts of accidents, disasters, unusual experiences, or encounters with wildlife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of people encountering bears is increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Testimony was gathered from witnesses to the accident.

examples.japanese: UFO⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧⟦ドキュメンタリー→ドキュメンタリー：05250_dokyumentarii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A documentary was broadcast in which UFO witnesses describe their experiences.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{遭遇|そうぐう}→遭遇：14384_souguu⟧ (encounter/meeting) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). The word ⟦{遭遇|そうぐう}→遭遇：14384_souguu⟧ typically implies an unexpected or chance encounter, so {遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ} often describes someone who has unexpectedly come across something noteworthy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧: testimony from witnesses
- {遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体験談|たいけんだん}→体験談：25618_taikendan⟧: firsthand account of an encounter
- {遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧: a witness recounts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧: eyewitness — specifically someone who saw something happen
- ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧: victim — someone who suffered harm
- ⟦{当事者|とうじしゃ}→当事者：12504_toujisha⟧: person involved — a party in an event or dispute
- ⟦{遭遇|そうぐう}→遭遇：14384_souguu⟧: encounter — the base verb-noun
